title: Professional Certificate in Understanding the Budgetary Concepts and Approaches
description: This course enables the learner to understand budgetary concepts prevailing in the organization to manage its finances.
longDescription: Understanding the introduction to the Budgeting. To learn the vital role in budget preparation.​ Understand the various types of Budgeting. To learn the type of budgeting approach. Understanding the advantages and disadvantages of the budgeting approach. To learn the various steps in preparing a budget.​ To study the concept of the master budget.​ To understand the behavioural implications of budgeting. This course enables the learner to understand budgetary concepts prevailing in the organization to manage its finances.
